root_idea.summary: The root centers on plunging into, or attacking, something hidden or below the surface, with the aim of reaching and bringing out what lies within.
root_idea.development: The literal sense is descent beneath water; the semantic development extends to penetrating obscure matters and eliciting concealed knowledge, works, or results.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form I perfect citation form غَاصَ rather than the Quranic imperfect surface form.
Displayed under the normalized singular intensive participial form غَوَّاصٌ rather than the inflected Quranic form.

senses.definition: To dive into, descend beneath, or enter water and bring out what is within it.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic imperfect describes divers acting for Solomon; the sense is the literal water-entry and retrieval action.

senses.definition: To penetrate an obscure or hidden matter and elicit what is concealed, including unusual works or extraordinary results.
senses.usage_conditions: May be used with عَلَى for delving into an affair or its meanings. In the Quranic interpretation of 21:82, the action is not restricted to extracting pearls from water but includes bringing forth strange works and wondrous actions.

senses.definition: One who dives repeatedly or habitually and brings out what is hidden; a practiced diver.
senses.usage_conditions: The intensive pattern conveys frequent or characteristic performance. In the Quranic occurrence it denotes a diver among Solomon’s servants, without restricting the object of diving to pearls.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Diving or descending beneath water; a dive or single act of diving.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: As an activity, this can specifically mean diving in the sea to fetch pearls or bringing pearls out from beneath the water.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A diver who repeatedly dives in the sea to fetch pearls or pearl-shells.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is the specialized maritime and pearl-diving use of the agent noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To pounce upon, or come suddenly and unexpectedly upon, a thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a conventional extension of the diving action to sudden attack upon an object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make someone dive or descend beneath water; to immerse, plunge, dip, or sink someone in it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form II is causative or transitive with a person or object made to enter the water.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who pounces upon or comes suddenly and unexpectedly upon a thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The corresponding intensive agent form may convey a stronger or more habitual sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Figuratively, a producer of choice, pearl-like expressions.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in an idiom comparing skilled expression-making with diving for pearls.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One skilled, crafty, or cunning in arranging the means of obtaining a livelihood.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative characterization of practical artfulness and resourcefulness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place where one dives or descends beneath water.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: It may specifically denote a place from which pearls are obtained, such as a pearl-diving ground.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The upper part of the ساق, or shank.
